@@U01507@@
(Grasps him and returns the kiss.)

@@U01508@@
Sweet man! I love you with all my heart!

@@U01509@@
(梅菲斯特 knocks.)

@@U01511@@
(Stomping his foot.)

@@U01512@@
Who's there?

@@U01514@@
A friend!

@@U01516@@
A beast!

@@U01518@@
I think it’s time to go.

@@U01520@@
(Entering.)

@@U01521@@
It’s really late, sir.

@@U01523@@
May I see you home?

@@U01525@@
My mother—no, good-bye!

@@U01527@@
Do I have to go, then? Good-bye!

@@U01529@@
Adieu!

@@U01531@@
See you soon.

@@U01532@@
(Exeunt 浮士德 and 梅菲斯特.)
